info.name: Returns a list of bank journal entries export summaries.

params.name: before
params.description: When specified, returns bank journals whose export date is before the given UTC date time

params.name: after
params.description: When specified, returns bank journals whose export date is after the given UTC date time

params.name: size
params.description: Number of bank journals to return

items.docs: Returns a list of short summaries of bank journal entries previous exports, without their entries. You can then use `exportId` of a summary to call the GET Export endpoint to retrieve the export content with its entries. The query pagination is based on a mandatory timestamp cursor whose value is specified either with the `after` parameter or the `before` parameter (but not both). It returns (at most) `size` bank journal exports whose export dates are either: - strictly aft

info.name: Get an existing bank journal entries export.

params.name: exportId
params.description: Unique ID of an existing bank journal export.

items.docs:
Retrieve an existing bank journal export by its identifier, with all its entries.

The bank journal export is returned as a JSON payload.

If the export is not found an error is returned.

info.name: Export bank journal entries ready to be exported.

params.name: exportId
params.description:
Unique ID of the export, provided by the caller. In case of network problem, use the same
unique ID to retry.

items.docs: Export all the bank journal entries ready to be exported. You need to provide the export id as a Guid The bank journal entries will become exported instead of ready to be exported and won't be exportable anymore, they can be retrieved later on with the same `exportId` with the GET Export endpoint.
